name: Protagonist
source:
To escape an arranged marriage forced by your father, refusing to surrender the rest of your life to a rumored 50-year-old "greasy" middle-aged man you never met, you escape and fled to Guangqi City.

Influenced by your grandmother, you pursued a career to become a fashion designer. You then participated in the fashion design competition arranged by Warson Group, which the final winner has the chance to release their own brand. Although your design didn't win as the final winner, later on got offer to join Warson group as Junior Fashion Designer.

Outfit, make-up, and birthday can be changed.
